title: Writer Assistant Core extraction orchestration planning and review-safe pipeline boundary
goal: Publish the planning and contract parent for sequencing existing source-map, evidence, raw storage, fixture parser, adapter normalization, candidate draft support, and owner-review pieces into a review-safe extraction pipeline boundary without implementing runtime extraction in T001.
why_now: PHASE8-IMPL-006 through PHASE8-IMPL-009 completed the foundation for evidence/source maps, raw artifact storage boundaries, mocked adapter normalization, pure in-memory BookNLP fixture parsing, and raw artifact bundle validation. The next gap is the orchestration contract that decides sequencing, failure behavior, and owner-review handoff before real runtime extraction, routes, UI, or persistence workflows.

include: Tests-first orchestration contract if authorized by T002.
Optional minimal pure orchestration helper only if later children authorize it.
Candidate review handoff and persistence boundary decision.
exclude: Extraction orchestrator module creation in T001.
Real BookNLP install, import, run, or execution.
Real spaCy install, import, run, or execution.
Real BookNLP output file parsing from disk.
Raw artifact write/read/list helpers into real projects.
Raw artifact files under real projects.
Automatic candidate JSON persistence from raw/parser output.
Generated prose, rewriting, continuation, imitation, polish, improvement, or expansion.
Model calls, Ollama calls, Story Check calls, demos, or app server runs.
Training data, JSONL records, dataset manifests, or model artifacts.

acceptance_criteria: Task record, inventory, and enrichment JSON are created.
PHASE8-IMPL-010 is active in roadmap/status docs.
T001 records PHASE8-IMPL-009 complete through T007.
T001 records PHASE8-IMPL-006 through PHASE8-IMPL-009 artifacts as the foundation.
No backend code, tests, routes, UI, packages, project runtime files, training data, JSONL records, or datasets are created.
No-prose and no-canon-mutation boundaries are preserved.
safety_notes: Owner review remains mandatory before anything can become approved truth.
Raw artifacts are non-canon and non-candidate.
Parser and adapter outputs remain support/draft material only unless a later owner-approved child defines a review-safe handoff.
context_tools_policy: No CCE, Graphify, Repomix, AI Context, MCP tools, or LeanCTX are authorized for T001.
external_tool_policy: No external tools are installed, cloned, fetched, pulled, executed, imported, copied, or vendored in T001.
orchestration_policy: The parent may define an orchestration contract and later tests, but T001 does not create an orchestrator module or runtime extraction behavior.
fixture_input_policy: Any first orchestration contract should prefer synthetic fixture inputs and existing in-memory parser helpers unless a later decision explicitly narrows otherwise.
raw_artifact_policy: Raw artifacts and raw artifact bundles are evidence support only; T001 adds no write/read/list helpers and no real project raw artifact files.
source_evidence_policy: Source maps, source locators, evidence records, and raw output references remain required boundaries for any future extraction handoff.
candidate_review_policy: Owner review is mandatory before parser/adapter/orchestration output can become candidate records or approved truth.
candidate_only_policy: Candidate draft support is not candidate truth, canon, memory, promotion, or approved story truth.
no_runtime_extraction_policy: No real BookNLP/spaCy runtime, extraction tool execution, backend extraction route, frontend extraction UI, or package/dependency change is authorized by T001.
